entitymodel.title: Finance Component Entity Model - Lease layer STEP L1-L2 (products, applications, quotes, agreements)
entitymodel.description: Lease products extend FinancialProduct 1:1 with lease-specific terms (FinancialProductLease). Leased assets reuse the core FixedAsset / FixedAssetType. A LeaseApplication is the lease-only application; the requested assets are LeaseApplicationAsset rows. Underwriting is the common review (LoanUnderwriting with applicationTypeId=LEASE).

field.name: productId
field.description: FK to FinancialProduct (1:1); the product type must be under LEASE

field.name: leaseClassEnumId
field.description: LEASE_CLASS: finance transfer / finance non-transfer / operating; derived from the product type

field.name: defaultMonthlyRateFactor
field.description: default monthly lease rate factor (monthly lease amount / acquisition cost, e.g. 0.018000)

field.name: defaultCalcInterestRate
field.description: default annual calculation interest rate of the lessor (e.g. 0.030000)

field.name: paymentTimingEnumId
field.description: LEASE_PAY_TIMING: ADVANCE (first payment at start) / ARREARS

field.name: residualValueRate
field.description: estimated residual value / acquisition cost (0 to 1); non-transfer default 0

field.name: revenueMethodEnumId
field.description: LEASE_REV_METHOD: revenue recognition method; initially LEASE_REV_AT_START

field.name: taxable
field.description: Y when lease payments are subject to consumption tax (default Y)

field.name: taxTimingEnumId
field.description: LEASE_TAX_TIMING: taxable sale per installment or lump sum at the lease start (STEP L5); empty = lease.tax.timing

field.name: reLeaseAnnualFactor
field.description: STEP L13: default annual re-lease fee / original monthly lease amount (e.g. 1.0 = one month per year); empty = lease.release.annual.factor

field.name: leaseApplicationId
field.description: primary sequenced ID

field.name: productId

field.name: applicantPartyId
field.description: prospective lessee (person or organization)

field.name: statusId

field.name: assetSeqId

field.name: estimatedAcquisitionCost

field.name: supplierPartyId
field.description: dealer / supplier the lessor buys the asset from

field.name: leaseQuoteId
field.description: primary sequenced ID

field.name: statusId
field.description: LEASE_QUOTE_STATUS; changed only by setLeaseQuoteStatus

field.name: calcMethodEnumId
field.description: LEASE_CALC_METHOD: rate factor or calculation interest rate

field.name: acquisitionCost
field.description: sum of the quoted asset acquisition costs (tax excluded)

field.name: residualValue
field.description: estimated residual value at the end of the term

field.name: paymentTimingEnumId
field.description: LEASE_PAY_TIMING

field.name: monthlyLeaseAmount
field.description: monthly lease payment (tax excluded)

field.name: monthlyRateFactor
field.description: monthly lease amount / acquisition cost

field.name: calcInterestRate

field.name: totalLeaseAmount

field.name: totalInterestAmount

field.name: taxRate

field.name: leaseStartDate

field.name: acquisitionCost

field.name: dueDate

field.name: periodFromDate
field.description: first day of the lease period covered by the payment

field.name: periodThruDate
field.description: last day of the lease period covered by the payment

field.name: leaseAmount
field.description: lease payment (tax excluded)

field.name: principalPortion
field.description: principal recovery (interest method)

field.name: interestPortion
field.description: interest equivalent (interest method)

field.name: remainingPrincipal
field.description: principal outstanding after the payment (ends at the residual value)

field.name: leaseAgreementId
field.description: primary sequenced ID

field.name: financeContractId
field.description: common contract ledger row (contractTypeId=LEASE, 1:1)

field.name: leaseQuoteId
field.description: accepted quote; one agreement per quote

field.name: statusId
field.description: LEASE_AGR_STATUS; changed only by the lease status services

field.name: organizationPartyId
field.description: lessor organization

field.name: supplierPartyId
field.description: supplier when all assets come from one supplier

field.name: firstPaymentDate
field.description: provisional until the lease start (STEP L3)

field.name: leaseStartDate
field.description: acceptance date = lease start (set in STEP L3)

field.name: leaseEndDate
field.description: set in STEP L3

field.name: taxTimingEnumId
field.description: LEASE_TAX_TIMING fixed at the lease start (STEP L5)

field.name: taxAuthPartyId
field.description: tax authority of the rate fixed at the lease start (empty = no core tax authority)

field.name: taxAuthorityRateSeqId
field.description: core TaxAuthorityRateProduct of the fixed rate

field.name: completedDate
field.description: date the lease was completed by return / ownership transfer (STEP L7)

field.name: leaseQuoteId
field.description: source quote of the revision

field.name: fixedAssetId
field.description: core FixedAsset owned by the lessor (STEP L3)

field.name: assetStatusId
field.description: LEASE_ASSET_STATUS: pending purchase / purchased / leased / returned / transferred (STEP L3)

field.name: usefulLifeYears
field.description: STEP L10: useful life in years for the property tax valuation (empty = finance.properties default)

field.name: municipalityGeoId
field.description: STEP L10: municipality (core Geo, MUNICIPALITY) where the asset is located; defaults from the FixedAsset facility address

field.name: ownershipShare
field.description: STEP L10b: lessor's ownership share of the asset (0 < share <= 1, e.g. a co-owned asset of a syndicated lease); empty = 1 (sole owner). Public charges are declared pro rata

field.name: reclassifiedResidual
field.description: STEP L13 (finance lease): residual value moved from the lease investment to leased assets (165500) at the first re-lease; depreciated over the re-lease

field.name: scheduleRevisionNumber

field.description: STEP L9: total of the billed payment components (tax excluded)

field.name: componentTaxAmount

field.name: billedAmount

field.name: leaseProfitRecognitionId
field.description: primary sequenced ID

field.name: fromDate
field.description: first day recognized (day start)

field.name: thruDate
field.description: last day recognized (day start, inclusive)

field.name: amount
field.description: interest equivalent recognized in the period

field.name: cumulativeAmount
field.description: cumulative recognized through thruDate

field.name: acctgTransId

field.name: invoiceId

field.name: leaseEndDate
field.description: lease end date the notice refers to

field.name: residualValue
field.description: residual value of the asset (agreement residual allocated by acquisition cost)

field.name: returnDate
field.description: return / pickup date (no ownership transfer)

field.name: transferDate
field.description: ownership transfer date (transfer leases)

field.name: disposalTypeEnumId
field.description: LEASE_DISPOSAL_TYPE (sale / scrap); transfer = sale to the lessee

field.name: disposalPartyId
field.description: buyer (sale) or the lessee (transfer)

field.name: proceedsAmount
field.description: sale / transfer price (tax excluded)

field.name: gainLossAmount
field.description: proceeds - residual (positive = gain)

field.name: acctgTransId
field.description: settlement of the residual value (none when residual and proceeds are 0)

field.name: acquisitionCost
field.description: STEP L12 (operating): acquisition cost of the leased asset removed at disposal

field.name: accumulatedDepreciation
field.description: STEP L12 (operating): accumulated depreciation removed at disposal; residualValue = book value

field.name: componentSeqId
field.description: line number within the quote (00001, 00002, ...)

field.name: componentTypeEnumId
field.description: LEASE_COMPONENT_TYPE: property tax / insurance / maintenance / other

field.name: monthlyAmount
field.description: level monthly component amount (tax excluded)

field.name: taxClassEnumId
field.description: LEASE_TAX_CLASS: taxable / exempt / non-taxable / zero-rated (免税)

field.name: revenueTreatmentEnumId
field.description: LEASE_CMP_REVENUE: separate revenue (区分, default) or included in the method-1 sales (含める)

field.name: totalAmount
field.description: monthly amount x term (tax excluded)

entity.title: Lease Quote - payment schedule component amount

field.description: component amount of the installment (tax excluded)

entity.title: Lease Agreement - confirmed payment schedule component amount
Lease public charge type (公租公課の税目)

field.name: calcMethodEnumId
field.description: LEASE_PCHG_CALC: VALUE (assessed value x rate, aggregated per jurisdiction with the 免税点) / UNIT (fixed annual amount per unit by rate class)

field.name: jurisdictionLevelEnumId
field.description: LEASE_PCHG_JUR: MUNICIPALITY (市町村) / PREFECTURE (都道府県, parent of the municipality by GeoAssoc REGIONS) / FIXED (jurisdictionGeoId, e.g. national JPN)

field.name: jurisdictionGeoId
field.description: fixed jurisdiction Geo for jurisdictionLevel FIXED

field.name: assessmentMonth
field.description: month of the assessment date (賦課期日) in the tax year: 1 for 償却資産税 (1/1), 4 for 自動車税 (4/1)

field.name: exemptionThreshold
field.description: 免税点 per declaration (VALUE): below it no charge is due; empty = none

field.name: baseRoundingUnit
field.description: VALUE: taxable base floored to this unit (1000 yen); empty = none

field.name: taxRoundingUnit
field.description: charge amount floored to this unit (100 yen); empty = currency rounding only

field.name: defaultTaxRate
field.description: VALUE: fallback rate when no rate row (no municipal / standard row) is valid

field.name: defaultUsefulLifeYears
field.description: VALUE: useful life used when the asset has none

field.name: componentTypeEnumId
field.description: LEASE_COMPONENT_TYPE of the L9 component the estimate is supplied to

field.name: expenseGlAccountTypeId
field.description: GL account type debited by the payment (租税公課)

field.name: payableGlAccountTypeId
field.description: GL account type credited by the payment (未払租税公課)

field.name: appliesToUnmapped
field.description: Y: applies to asset types with no LeasePublicChargeAssetType row (general depreciable assets)

field.name: applicable
field.description: N excludes the charge type for the asset type (empty = Y)

field.name: taxableBaseRatio
field.description: VALUE: special ratio of the taxable base (課税標準の特例, e.g. vessels); empty = 1

entity.title: Lease public charge rate (税率・税額表)

field.name: rateClassCode

field.name: taxRate
field.description: VALUE: annual rate (fraction, e.g. 0.014)

field.name: unitAmount

field.name: standardRate
field.description: Y for the fallback row used when the jurisdiction has no row

entity.title: Lease agreement asset - public charge attributes
Lease public charge declaration (公租公課の申告)

field.name: leasePublicChargeDeclId
field.description: primary sequenced ID

field.name: organizationPartyId
field.description: lessor organization (declarant / owner)

field.name: taxYear
field.description: tax year (assessed as of the charge type's assessment date)

field.name: jurisdictionGeoId
field.description: core Geo the declaration is filed with (municipality / prefecture / country)

field.name: totalAssessedValue
field.description: VALUE: sum of the asset assessed values after the ownership share

field.name: taxableBase
field.description: VALUE: taxable base (after the special ratio, floored); 0 when below the exemption threshold

field.name: taxRate

field.name: statusId

field.description: LeasePropertyTaxDecl id this row was migrated from (STEP L10b)

entity.title: Lease public charge declaration - asset line

field.name: ownershipShare
field.description: lessor's share applied (1 = sole owner)

field.name: usefulLifeYears
field.description: VALUE

field.name: depreciationRate
field.description: VALUE: annual depreciation rate used (旧定率法相当)

field.name: fullAssessedValue
field.description: VALUE: valuation of the whole asset as of the assessment date (下限 5%)

field.name: assessedValue
field.description: VALUE: fullAssessedValue x ownershipShare

field.name: taxableBaseRatio
field.description: VALUE: special ratio applied (課税標準の特例)

field.name: taxableValue
field.description: VALUE: assessedValue x taxableBaseRatio

field.name: rateClassCode
field.description: UNIT

field.name: unitAmount
field.description: UNIT: annual amount per unit

field.name: chargeAmount
field.description: UNIT: unitAmount x quantity x ownershipShare

entity.title: Municipal property tax rate (償却資産税率)

field.name: leasePropertyTaxRateId
field.description: primary sequenced ID

field.description: core Geo (MUNICIPALITY, geoCode = 6-digit local government code); empty = the standard rate used when a municipality has no row

field.name: taxRate
field.description: annual property tax rate (fraction, e.g. 0.014 for 1.4%)

field.description: Y for the fallback standard rate (1.4%); only one active standard row

entity.title: Lease property tax declaration (償却資産税申告)

field.name: leasePropertyTaxDeclId
field.description: primary sequenced ID

field.name: organizationPartyId
field.description: lessor organization (declarant / owner)

field.name: taxYear

field.name: municipalityGeoId
field.description: core Geo (MUNICIPALITY) the declaration is filed with

field.name: totalAssessedValue
field.description: sum of the asset assessed values (課税標準額の基礎)

field.name: taxableBase
field.description: taxable base (floored to 1000 yen); 0 when below the exemption threshold

field.name: exemptionThreshold
field.description: 免税点 (1,500,000); below it no tax is due

field.name: belowThreshold
field.description: Y when the total assessed value is below the exemption threshold (免税点未満)

field.name: taxRate
field.description: municipal rate applied (standard 1.4% unless the municipality has an excess rate)

field.name: taxAmount
field.description: property tax due (0 when below the threshold)

field.name: statusId

entity.title: Lease property tax declaration - asset line

field.description: annual depreciation rate used (旧定率法相当)
